result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major content bug showing an untranslated localization key as a section title, and a minor layout issue with a truncated restaurant name.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw localization/i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the proper translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you' or equivalent) and ensure localization fallbacks are in place.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, use a shorter display name, or ensure card width and typography accommodate full names without clipping.
